pages.text: You were never alone out here. The others keep close and look after themselves: they root for food, pick up what is worth having, and pull a branch from a tree when they feel unsafe.
When something goes for you, they go for it. When you go for something, so do they - so choose what you anger.$(br2)Hand them food, a weapon, anything. With empty hands, they hand you something back.

Call, and they call with you. One voice is a bluff; several is a reason to leave.$(br2)$(k:sneak) and $(k:use) on one to learn who they are. $(k:sneak) and $(k:attack) to wrestle - play fighting is how fighting is learned.

Feed a male and a female close together, and in a day there may be one more of you. Every kind of hominin lives in a band of its own size, and the land will only feed so many.$(br2)If you die, the band does not. Nor, quite, do you.
There are other bands. They will not follow you, but they carry things.$(br2)Hold out something of yours and offer it. If they have something worth as much, they will give it.

Press $(k:hominin_evolution.social) near your band to talk to them: to forage, to ask for food or a tool, or to say you are hurt. Near another band, ask them to walk with you for the day. Sneak-use one member first to talk to just them.
Stragglers find their way back to you.$(br2)Lose a whole band and some of what you learned is lost with it. Lose three, and your line ends.

$(l)Worth, to another band$()$(br)Everything falls into a tier. Trade for anything of the same tier or lower, never higher.$(br2)1 Common: food, sticks, rocks$(br)2 Useful: long branch, termite stick, quartzite$(br)3 Crafted: flake, Lomekwian core, chert$(br)4 Prized: chopper, spear

$(l)Treasured$()$(br)Top of the tiers: $(#b87333)obsidian$(), a $(#b87333)chert hammerstone$(), an $(#b87333)Oldowan multi tool$().$(br2)Worth is not fixed. Tools a band has never made are treasure to them; tools their ancestors made, they barely value.

Each of them carries nine things: two in the hands, seven more. Full up, they drop the least worth keeping for something better. They take out what the moment needs - a weapon when danger is near, a stick to dig or fish termites with, food in hand when hungry.$(br2)From habilis on, a big band splits into parties by day and comes together at night. Only those near you will come if you are attacked.

Frightened, the body decides: fight, stronger and harder to hurt, or flight, fast - up a tree, or later, back to the band. Sometimes it decides nothing, and they freeze until the band comes for them. It takes five minutes to happen again.

From habilis, they are their own people. Each favours a stone - chert or quartzite - and a few cannot leave obsidian alone, and will not hand it over for anything. They go out and break rocks on their own account, and they will tell you what they think of limestone.$(br2)Now and then one wants something, and says so, or offers you a trade for something you carry. Give them what they asked for, or their favourite food, and they remember it.

A member who is fond of you looks after you unasked: food when you are going hungry, a better weapon than the one you have, a hammerstone when you have none.$(br2)Sneak-use one and press $(k:hominin_evolution.social), then Info, to see who they are - sex, health, hunger, favourite foods, what they want, and how much they trust you.

Grooming is what holds a band together, and it costs the one thing that means anything: time. Sneak-use one of them, press $(k:hominin_evolution.social), then Groom, and stay beside them while you pick through their hair.$(br2)They do it to each other too, and on a hot day they will wade into a river to wash. By erectus there is too little hair left to pick, so it becomes cleaning instead - and one day, for sapiens, it becomes talk.

If the last of them dies, you do not simply carry on. Your chest closes, your eyes shut, and you come back to yourself ninety blocks away with a new band around you.$(br2)What you were stays where it happened, sitting with its head in its hands. Walk back and find it, and it will get up and come with you.
